# peakhour_reverse_proxy_service (Resource)

Enables the Reverse Proxy (CDN) service for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_reverse_proxy_service" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name to enable the service for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_reverse_proxy_service.example example.com
```
